Description: Muting a room doesn't fully suppress desktop notifications.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Mute a busy channel
2) Enable desktop notifications
3) Receive mentions/non-mentions
4) Notifications still appear

Description: Composer draft disappears when navigating between rooms quickly.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Type a long draft in #general
2) Switch to another room and back within 2s
3) Draft is gone

Description: After inserting emoji, Shift+Enter inserts nothing or sends message.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Open composer
2) Insert emoji via picker
3) Press Shift+Enter
4) No newline or message sent unexpectedly

Description: Adding then removing a reaction leaves a stale count.
Steps to reproduce:
1) React to a message
2) Remove same reaction
3) Counter remains at 1 for other viewers until refresh

Bug: Edit not reflected in thread preview
Description: Editing a thread reply doesn't update the parent thread preview snippet.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Reply in a thread
2) Edit the reply text
3) Thread list preview shows old content
